The CI passes all workflows. However, if a tester wants a quick sanity check: open the app in light mode and confirm the success dot and error notices use visibly darker green/red than before.

subject: test(app): add light theme contrast checks and fix accessibility issues (#3948)
summary: Adds automated axe-core text contrast checks for both light and dark themes across five primary GUI views, and fixes two WCAG AA contrast violations in light mode by darkening the success green token (#4CAF50→#2C702F) and error red token (#f44336→#C62828) in both tokens.css and critical.generated.css.
verdict_reason: Small, well-scoped accessibility fix with passing CI, approved after the reviewer confirmed both automated findings were addressed, and no post-approval commits.
